description: This file contains unit tests for the GrainDirectoryResolver class in an Orleans-based project. It tests directory resolution logic including custom directory resolution, default directory handling, and listing all directories.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryResolverTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the GrainDirectoryResolver functionality, including custom directory resolution, default directory handling, and directory listing.

methods.name: UserProvidedDirectory
methods.description: Tests that the resolver correctly returns a user-provided custom directory.

methods.name: DefaultDhtDirectory
methods.description: Tests that the resolver returns null for the default directory type.

methods.name: ListAllDirectories
methods.description: Tests that all registered directories are correctly listed by the resolver.
